newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 27.

text.p: Following were the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Sri Lanka government releases 18 chapters of the draft constitution on Wednesday and says sweeping win in last week's local government poll has strengthened its hand to push ahead with reform. The ruling People's Alliance coalition won 194 of the 238 local councils at stake.
Republic of Sri Lanka to be indissoluble union of regions according to chapters of new draft constitution released on Wednesday.

Abolishing executive presidency, making senior government appointments through a parliamentary committee and defining Sri Lanka an indissoluble union of regions are hallmarks of the draft constitution.
Police to begin investigating 2,800 violations of election laws in the runup to last week's local government poll.
Abolishing executive presidency, and reverting to full parliamentary democracy cornerstones of the draft constitution.
